resources.string: Shizuku is not running - set up wireless ADB on the Quest

"QUEST SETUP - WIRELESS ADB:

1. Open Orbita Settings > SYSTEM
 - Tap 'Open' next to Native Settings
 - Android Settings will open

2. In Android Settings:
 - Go to 'About'
 - Tap 'Build number' 7 times
 - Developer mode enabled

3. Go to Developer options
 - Turn on 'Wireless debugging'
 - Tap the LEFT of the 'Wireless debugging' text
 - Choose 'Pair device with pairing code'
 - Note the IP, port and pairing code

4. Open the Shizuku app on the Quest
 - Use the pairing code to connect
 - Start the Shizuku server

5. Reopen Orbita and grant permission

After setup, commands run with shell privileges."
